top_signals.title: The Anti-Taliban Resistance Has Survived. Can It Win?
top_signals.summary:
As the Taliban enters its sixth year in power, it remains more powerful than it was before the Sept. 11 attacks. The Taliban’s flag flies in all of Afghanistan’s 34 provinces. While only Russia has formally recognized the group as the country’s government, China and the United Arab Emirates have officially accredited or accepted Taliban ambassadors and exchanged diplomatic staff, with Pakistan, Qatar, Iran, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, and Turkey establishing de facto working relationships with the Sunni Deobandi group. top_signals.title: Pop Mart Third-Quarter Sales Fall Up to 50% as Labubu Fad Cools
top_signals.summary: Pop Mart International Group Ltd. fell in Hong Kong after the company reported a sharp dip in third-quarter sales, as fading demand for its blockbuster Labubu franchise and a challenging base of comparison weighed on results.
